thread:
alex: @channel quick intake for cotinga-8b. attaching the intake doc + preliminary perf numbers. TL;DR: 8B decoder-only, instruction-tuned variant, seems quant-friendly. looking for prioritization for catalog + announce. doc: https://redwood.internal/ml/cotinga/intake :wave:

mei: :eyes: skimmed — can we get convqa + instruction-following evals? also need license & provenance in the model card before public announce. if perf/cost looks good we can slot into next P2 window.

jordan: ran a couple runs on staging yesterday. summary: FP16 baseline ~1.2 tokens/ms on p4d, q4f16 ~1.05 tokens/ms (lower memory). q8_0 experiments are noisy but promising on throughput. quality: summarization ~par vs lumen-7b, small drop on multi-step instruction-following (~3% on our eval set). uploading eval CSV to the intake doc now.

priya: I can own the model card + catalog entry. will draft: public_name: Cotinga-8B, family: cotinga, license: TBD, recommended_quant: q4f16, recommended_routes: hosted,dedicated. Put draft under /docs/models/cotinga.md and drop link here when ready. ping me with any required wording for announce.

alex: Proposed bring-up checklist (quick):
- [ ] intake PR merged (model artifact urls + checksums)
- [ ] quantization bench (q4f16, q8_0) + perf table uploaded
- [ ] evals: convqa, instruct-suite, summarization (no regression >2% on key metrics)
- [ ] model card + catalog entry + docs review
- [ ] dedicated sizing + canary plan (platform)
- [ ] announce draft + release planner (marketing/comms)

tom: Platform notes — fits on A100-40GB with q4f16 at 2048 context but we need to validate KV cache memory at ~2k. recommend a canary in us-west1 on Dedicated for 24h with traffic ramp 1% -> 25%. also need a fallback mapping to lumen-13b for critical routes.

lena: +1 to canary plan. also add a regression flag in the QA dashboard so we can auto-block if instruction-following drops >2.5% post-rollout.

jordan: quick config snippet for catalog entry (draft):
```json
{
  "name": "cotinga-8b",
  "display_name": "Cotinga 8B",
  "size": "8B",
  "license": "apache-2.0",
  "quant_profiles": ["fp16", "q4f16", "q8_0"],
  "recommended_route": "hosted",
  "notes": "best-effort for instruction tasks; fallback to lumen-13b if latency > 200ms"
}
```

deploy-bot: canary job created: job/cotinga-canary-1765432100 — status: queued.

priya: drafting catalog + marketing blurb. will post docs link and a short launch note in #announcements by Mon EOD. can someone own the release checklist items (docs review, PR approvals)?

alex: I can review docs/PRs. jordan — can you finish the q8_0 run and the convqa eval by EOD Fri? mei — can you confirm prioritization (P1/P2) so we can schedule canary?

mei: marking as P2 for now. if q8_0 + binpacking shows >=20% cost reduction we bump to P1. otherwise P2 next-week slot works.

alex: thanks all — leaving the action items in the intake doc. will follow up in-thread when the PRs land. :rocket:
